blocks.label: gray code recursive reflection (LC89)
blocks.py:
def gray(n):
    if n == 0: return [0]
    prev = gray(n - 1)
    return prev + [x | (1 << (n-1)) for x in reversed(prev)]
# closed form: g(i) = i ^ (i >> 1)

blocks.label: Hanoi — print moves
blocks.py:
def hanoi(n, src, help_, dst, moves):
    if n == 0: return
    hanoi(n-1, src, dst, help_, moves)
    moves.append((src, dst))
    hanoi(n-1, help_, src, dst, moves)
